items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: While married to Maria, I was playing in the orchestra at the university

ctx.x: So, how did you meet your second wife?

While married to Maria, I was playing in the orchestra at the university, and then one day, a beautiful woman, when I finished playing my Saturday at the orchestra there, uh, we were packing and we were ready to go to have dinner in the university, so this beautiful woman dressed all in white, she was sitting in the middle of the audience. Everybody left, so I approach her, and I say, “What are you doing here, you’re so pretty.” And she say, “Well, I am here to watch your instrument while you go to have dinner.”…
You were married 10 years the second time.
